_idea: r7 DDP on 2xT4 (OJ-062) on the fixed multi-length bench set: gradient all-reduce every optimizer step
_hypothesis: each rank runs 2 of the 4 micro-batches per step, so weighted samples/s ~1.8-1.9x the 1-GPU baseline minus the all-reduce of the LoRA grads
_reference: Li et al. 2020, PyTorch Distributed, arXiv:2006.15704

_idea: r7 local SGD K=50 on 2xT4 (OJ-062) on the fixed multi-length bench set
_hypothesis: no per-step all-reduce. NOTE: a trial has only 6 optimizer steps (1 warm-up + 5 buckets x 1), so K=50 never averages inside the timed loop: this measures no-sync 2-rank speed (the upper bound for DDP)
_reference: Lin et al. 2020, Don't Use Large Mini-Batches, Use Local SGD, arXiv:1808.07217
